requirements.requirement: Generate the previous fully completed Monday-Sunday week and previous fully completed calendar month deterministically
requirements.action: Use one completed_period implementation for CLI, GUI and scheduled execution
requirements.test: focused calendar tests plus 10000 randomized calendar invariants
requirements.evidence: M5 Linux and Windows runtime logs
requirements.pass_criterion: No current or partial period can be selected

requirements.requirement: Reuse the governed finance profile, detailed-financial parser, calculate_by_group and existing output bundle writer
requirements.action: Call the existing calculation and export boundaries without duplicating formulas
requirements.test: source contract and mocked integration tests
requirements.evidence: focused tests and full source CI
requirements.pass_criterion: No parallel financial formula or report renderer exists

requirements.requirement: Accept only exact non-overlapping source coverage for the requested period
requirements.action: Reject gaps, overlaps and source report periods that partially cross the target boundary
requirements.test: exact, adjacent, gap, overlap and partial-period regressions
requirements.pass_criterion: Ambiguous source coverage fails closed before calculation

requirements.requirement: Bind source bytes, report periods, tenant and finance profile into a deterministic input identity
requirements.action: Verify each source SHA-256 immediately before parsing and calculate a canonical input hash
requirements.test: source hash tamper and idempotent identity regressions
requirements.pass_criterion: Changed source or profile produces a different package identity; hash mismatch blocks output

requirements.requirement: Write Excel, dashboard, finance JSON, recommendation JSON, short text summary and manifest atomically
requirements.action: Generate in same-volume staging, fsync, validate hashes, rename and update latest pointer atomically
requirements.pass_criterion: A failed run cannot expose an incomplete package or corrupt the previous valid package

requirements.requirement: Make repeated and missed scheduled runs safe
requirements.action: Run both due periods daily, reuse an existing validated identity and retain bounded persistent outcomes
requirements.test: idempotent reuse and failed new revision preservation regressions
requirements.pass_criterion: Repeated execution does not recalculate identical inputs and the next daily trigger recovers a missed day

requirements.requirement: Reject path traversal, POSIX absolute paths, Windows drive paths, UNC paths, symlinks and tampered state
requirements.action: Validate portable relative paths and package hashes fail closed
requirements.test: portable path, state tamper and artifact validation regressions
requirements.pass_criterion: Unsafe path state blocks before calculation or output

requirements.requirement: Use Windows Task Scheduler only as an external daily trigger of the same governed Python command
requirements.action: Register a LIMITED daily schtasks task that invokes --kind due; verify registration with /Query
requirements.test: command construction, registration, verification and non-Windows rejection tests
requirements.artifact: Windows scheduled task Quantum Scheduled Reports <root hash>
requirements.pass_criterion: No second scheduler engine or duplicate reporting implementation is introduced

requirements.requirement: Expose manual weekly/monthly generation, schedule enablement and output-folder access on the existing Reports page
requirements.action: Add one mixin and one control row without changing the navigation or approved visual structure
requirements.pass_criterion: The exact 11 navigation labels remain unchanged

requirements.requirement: Keep imports and scheduled reports mutually controlled and keep the GUI responsive
requirements.action: Reject report launch while the sequential import queue is busy and run report actions on a background thread using the existing event queue
requirements.test: GUI mixin and queue delegation contracts
requirements.evidence: focused source tests and full CI
requirements.pass_criterion: No report calculation runs on the Tk main thread or concurrently with active imports

requirements.requirement: Preserve WB_ONLY, Ozon deferred, Gatekeeper disconnected and marketplace writes disabled
requirements.action: Validate configuration and emit fixed safety fields in every report outcome and evidence file
requirements.test: static boundary scan, Foundation, OSS, M7, M8, L4 and same-artifact gates
requirements.pass_criterion: No write enablement, Ozon activation, Gatekeeper connection or UI navigation change

requirements.requirement: Publish M5 as exactly one direct-parent commit over the current validated M4 corrective exact head and limit completion to supported evidence
requirements.action: Preserve M4 corrective R99, append M5 as R100, create one clean exact-head candidate, run all required gates, and close validation PR unmerged
requirements.test: commit ancestry, changed-file allow-list and exact-head workflow results
requirements.pass_criterion: One commit over M4 corrective R99; L5 remains explicitly unclaimed; release remains blocked
